notes.title: 25 October Patch notes
notes.content:
A bit of unneeded background 
Hopefully I can regain and post some more updates as I got motivated and inspired for certain problems of the game. Unfortunately it's a tough period both personal and financial wise, so not sure how much the spark will last to be honest, but nonetheless Dough will still get updates even if they might get slim at times.

If you wish to support Dough spread the word or leave a positive review. 

I don't know how many more people might be interested in buying Dough in the future, it might be smarter financial wise to start from the core of Dough and create a crime game spanning whole of US, having multiple cities instead of one, but also fixing some of Dough issues. This are all stuff that are weighting down on me lol, sorry if I'm bothering your, as I have a huge motivation to create great games but it won't matter if I can be financially stable. Not thinking about abandoning Dough though, it won't make any sense whatsoever to do that. Come and join the discord we might have a talk about any subject.

Changed order of hire employee and search for employee in tutorial
Changed order of when upgrade headquarters for max dirty money shows up
